elements.name: Aven
elements.desc: Aven is the language of the bird-like humanoids native to Amonkhet. It consists of sharp clicks, whistles, and complex vocalizations.

elements.name: Khenra
elements.desc: Khenra is the language of the jackal-headed twins of Amonkhet. It is characterized by sharp barks, growls, and yips.

elements.name: Merfolk
elements.desc: Merfolk is the language of the aquatic humanoids of Ixalan and Zendikar. It sounds melodic and flowing, carrying easily through water.

elements.name: Naga
elements.desc: Naga is the language of the serpentine people of Amonkhet. It is characterized by long, sibilant hisses and complex tongue movements.

elements.name: Siren
elements.desc: Siren is the language of the bird-like merfolk of Ixalan. It is highly musical, filled with trills and soaring notes.

elements.name: Vampire
elements.desc: The ancient language of the vampires of Ixalan and Zendikar. It is a harsh, guttural tongue used for rituals and commanding lesser creatures.

elements.name: Kor Silent Speech
elements.desc: The silent speech of the kor is a complex nonverbal language of hand signs and gestures that allows communication despite significant distance or howling winds.
